name: @meloduo/mcp
description: MCP bridge for Meloduo, a browser DAW: lets any MCP client edit the project open in your browser tab.
author: Ilya Shumchenko <meloduo.demo@gmail.com>

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts src/daemon.ts src/stop.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outdir=dist --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist/guides',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('../guides','dist/guides',{recursive:true})"
